name: quantech-vid-local-studio
description: Visible cross-browser companion for the local QuaNTecH-ViD studio

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:edge && npm run build:firefox
scripts.package: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:edge && npm run package:firefox
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext build -s dist/chrome -a releases/chrome --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:edge: npm run build:edge && web-ext build -s dist/edge -a releases/edge --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build -s dist/firefox -a releases/firefox --overwrite-dest
